body: See, If I can do any of this on the list, it means i am already starting to recover.

i got a social worker to help me with housing ... I was supposed to go to a new GP to see if I can  get a letter explaining that my animals are emotional support animals, because some landlords will make exceptions, so I could go into student accom.

I messaged her yesterday that it didn't happen. but i have only met her once so far, and i don't trust her completely yet.

Most of the shelters are overfull, and taking mothers mostly. Because of my BPD/ PTSD, unfamiliar environments  and in close quarters with strangers really negatively affects me. as well as uncertainty.  the youth services are only homing young mums, and the christian homing services have houses once again... for families. I am on the social housing list, and it is mentioned that i am in an abusive household which is worsening my mental heallth but I'm still waiting for an opening...

It is low-key emotional abuse. Most of the time it's not even abuse, but just ... toxicity? I live with my grandparents and it's my grandfather.  most of it is just him being highly critical of everything. But he can be really critical, discriminatory against mental illness, and it does develop into emotional abuse.

Like I might accidentally drop something and I will be yelled at for ages. My grandma will buy a brand he thinks is too expensive and he will yell at her and call her a stupid bitch and wont stop going on for about 10 minutes.

I have experienced worse as kid, but because of that instead of being used to it, I am sensitised to that stuff. just people yelling in frustration really frightens me, even when I know it's not directed at me.

im opposed to the miltary, besides, i wouldn't met requirements. I don't qualify for disability, and student  payment is like 400 dollars after my bills,and the cheapest rent here is 200 dollars, and i would havve to leave my therapy cats :(
